newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Brothers crushed to death by rubbish mangler.
newsitem.headline: Brothers crushed to death by rubbish mangler.

text.p: The remains of two young Swedish brothers were identified on Saturday after they crawled into a paper recycling container and were crushed to death by the truck that collected the paper, police said.

Police in the central Swedish town of Norberg said the brothers, aged six and 10, appeared to have crawled into the tiny holes into which newspapers and cardboard is placed for recycling while they were playing.
The two boys disappeared early on Friday evening and dozens of police and neighbours searched through the night for them.
Police said the boys would have died instantly when the collection truck automatically emptied the container's contents into the belly of the truck and a metal crusher squashed the contents flat.
Police spokesman Gunnar Keventer said the remains of the boys were identified on Saturday afternoon in the collection truck.
The driver of the recycling truck was being treated in hospital for shock, police said.

There are about 30,000 such recycling containers in Sweden. The holes for putting in newspapers are deliberately made very small to avoid the possibility of anyone getting inside the container, police added.
